fidelity._comment_SYMBOL_COLUMN: Column in the positions export containing the ticker/symbol. Defaults to 'Symbol' for Fidelity-style CSVs.
fidelity._comment_VALUE_COLUMN: Column in the positions export containing the current value. Defaults to 'Current Value'. Value will be cleaned of $ and commas.
fidelity._comment_SAFE_ASSET: Ticker that absorbs residual allocation. _CASH = consolidated cash pool defined by CASH_POOL_TICKERS. A real ticker like KISS gets explicit allocation + residual, netted into one trade.
